info.name: Public Swagger API - Detect
author: pdteam
c-sh0
amirhossein raeisi
eduardo quintanilha
info.description: Public Swagger API was detected.

curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: text/html, application/json' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:1.9.5.20) Gecko/ Firefox/3.8' 'http://api:8000/docs'

curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Host: auth-gateway' -H 'Origin: https://xjabg.com' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64; rv:140.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/140.0' 'http://auth-gateway/realms/cybersecurity'

info.name: Nginx version detect
author: philippedelteil
daffainfo
info.description: Some nginx servers have the version on the response header. Useful when you need to find specific CVEs on your targets.

curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux i686; rv:1.9.6.20) Gecko/ Firefox/4.0' 'http://auth-gateway/realms/cybersecurity'

info.name: Keycloak OpenID Configuration - Detect
author: rodnt
info.description: Keycloak Openid configuration information was detected.

curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; CrOS x86_64 14541.0.0) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/137.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' 'http://auth-gateway/realms/cybersecurity/.well-known/openid-configuration'
